topStories.headline: H-E-B to Build $38 Million Replacement Store in Ennis, Doubling Its Size
topStories.dek: The San Antonio-based grocer has filed plans for a 112,000-square-foot store at North Sonoma Trail and East Ennis Avenue, more than twice the size of the downtown location it has operated since 1972.
topStories.body:
H-E-B announced this week that it will replace its long-standing Ennis store at 101 S. Clay St. with a new 112,000-square-foot location at the corner of North Sonoma Trail and East Ennis Avenue. The project carries a price tag of $38.2 million, according to a filing with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. Construction is set to begin in mid-2027, with the new store expected to open by late 2028.

The existing downtown store will remain open until the new location is operational. H-E-B has not announced plans for what will happen to the Clay Street property once it closes, though the company said current store partners will have the opportunity to transition to the new location, with additional job postings to follow.

The new store will include a full-service pharmacy with drive-through, curbside pickup, home delivery, and H-E-B's South Flo Pizza. Ennis is a growing community — the city had roughly 26,000 residents as of last year, up more than 25 percent from the 2020 census — and H-E-B said the store's design will reflect the character of the community.

topStories.headline: Lions' Season Ends in a Thriller: Belton Escapes With 35-33 Bi-District Win
topStories.dek: Ennis stayed within two points of Belton all night on November 13 but could not hold on, closing a 5-6 season with no further playoff games scheduled.
topStories.body:
The Ennis Lions' 2026 playoff run lasted one game. Playing Belton in the Class 5A Division II bi-district round on November 13, Ennis fell 35-33 in a game that came down to the final moments. The Lions' season record finished at 5-6, good for third place in district.

Belton quarterback Will Shepard was the difference-maker for the Tigers, rushing for 36 yards and two touchdowns while also throwing for 243 yards and one score. Belton receiver Gavin Ross added 124 receiving yards and a touchdown. Despite the loss, the Lions kept it competitive throughout, turning what could have been a blowout into a two-point game.

With no additional games scheduled, the loss closes the book on the Lions' 2026 season. Attention in the community now turns to basketball, where the Lady Lions have already begun their new season.

topStories.headline: EISD Board Meets With Search Firm as Superintendent Hunt Advances
topStories.dek: The Ennis ISD board of trustees sat down with Impact Educational Services on Tuesday, November 11, to set priorities as the district seeks a permanent replacement for departed superintendent Dr. Greg Bradley.
topStories.body:
Ennis Independent School District's seven-member board of trustees met with its chosen search firm, Impact Educational Services, this week to begin setting priorities for the superintendent search. The district has been without a permanent superintendent since Dr. Greg Bradley departed earlier this fall; Keith Boles is serving as interim superintendent, a role that began November 11.

The school district, which serves about 6,000 students across ten-plus campuses, is soliciting community input as part of the search process. The district's website and social media channels are asking parents and community members to share their views on what qualities they want to see in the next leader. The search firm is a professional education recruitment organization brought in to help structure and conduct the national search.

In a related development, Ennis Daily News reported this week that Dr. Bradley has returned to Prosper ISD, where he previously served before leading Ennis ISD. The Ennis board has not announced a timeline for naming a permanent superintendent.

moreNews.headline: Ellis County Road Closures Updated as of November 19
moreNews.body: The Ellis County website posted an updated road closure list on November 19, 2026. Among the ongoing closures: the 500 block of Harris Road at Hog Creek (between Dillworth Road and Morgan Road) remains closed due to a TxDOT project, and the bridge on Bethel Road at the 600 block of Frost Creek is also closed for the foreseeable future due to a separate TxDOT project. Drivers should check elliscountytx.gov for the latest list before traveling county roads.
